summary: Global/History fully decoded: class tag 0x0538, upgrade format-version list (ends 2662 = Revit 2026 in all six), and a newest-first array of 17-byte episode records (GUID + constant 0x28) whose entry 0 equals BasicFileInfo's Unique Document GUID and whose tail entries are 2001-era v1 GUIDs — i.e. ADocument::m_pHistory is the model's save/episode history. Global/ContentDocuments is NOT embedded gzip blobs: it is an ordered map keyed by 16-byte GUID (strictly memcmp-ascending keys, 12-byte a3 03 ff ff ff ff a2 03 ff ff ff ff entry markers, 100% payload coverage) of embedded ADocument-shaped 'content documents' (60 in racbasic), each carrying an owner-family ElementId, a 0x0644 element table of 40-byte records, and (for large entries) family default view names — strongly indicating the embedded family/content documents; every key cross-references into Global/Latest and one Partitions block. Also established the true Global/* envelope: per-stream-type 8-byte prefix, a real gzip trailer (valid for History/small streams, stale for CD/ElemTable/Latest), an end signature 00 00 ff ff 02 0c 00, zero padding and an opaque footer; plus a segment-recovery inflater for the deflate holes that break CD in racadv/dach (and ElemTable in dach/rme).
key_findings: Envelope (all 36 Global streams): 8-byte prefix is a per-stream-TYPE constant (CD/History/DocumentIncrementTable=1, ElemTable/PartitionTable=0, Latest=5), then a 10-byte gzip header, raw deflate ending with signature 00 00 ff ff 02 0c 00 (sync-flush stored block + two empty fixed blocks, last FINAL), then a genuine gzip trailer (crc32,isize), 0–443 zero pad bytes, then a 37–350 B opaque high-entropy footer (History clusters at 91 B).

Trailer refined: CRC32+ISIZE VALIDATE exactly for History/DocumentIncrementTable/PartitionTable in all six files (racbasic History crc 0xa3525784, isize 15,290), but are STALE for the appended streams ContentDocuments/ElemTable/Latest (ISIZE < actual in every file; racbasic CD 5,080,768 vs 5,106,253). Never validate the big streams by trailer.

Global/History layout (verified 6/6, lengths reconcile exactly): u16 tag 0x0538, u16 ver 1, zeros, u32 count(dup), 5 GUID header slots (G,G,G,ZERO,G — G found nowhere else in the file), u32 nver + ascending u32 format versions, u32 nent + nent x 17-byte records (GUID bytes_le + constant 0x28), trailing u32 0.

History semantics: entry 0 == BasicFileInfo 'Unique Document GUID' / last-reload episode GUID in all six; entries run newest->oldest — trailing entries are v1 time GUIDs decoding to 2001-02-13 (MAC 00:00:86:3f:27:ad); related Autodesk samples share hundreds of episode GUIDs (racbasic∩rstbasic=737) while independent files share none. => m_pHistory = per-episode save/sync history + upgrade-version history (472..2662).

Format version 2662 (last entry of every History version list) is the same u32 in Global/Latest's ADocument header (66 0a) — the internal file-format version of Revit 2026; embedded content documents carry 2660.

Global/ContentDocuments = ordered GUID-keyed map: entries start with a3 03 ff ff ff ff a2 03 ff ff ff ff (two class-tagged null pointers) + 16-byte GUID key (bytes_le, strictly ascending) + u32 L; not length-prefixed (entry ends at next marker); walking + monotonic-key validation covers 100% of the payload in all six files (60/26/32/27 entries in racbasic/rstbasic/rme/rstadv; 17/14 in the recovered racadv/dach payloads).

Each CD entry is an ADocument-shaped embedded document: bytes at +0x20 are byte-identical to Global/Latest's opening tag sequence except two extra tagged fields; tag 0x0538 = null m_pHistory (0x0538 is History's class tag), tag 0x0ae9 precedes a u64 ElementId that is -1 in the host Latest but a real host element id per entry (racbasic 1,018,036, 1,031,505, …) — strong hypothesis: m_ownerFamilyId, the owning Family element.

First body block of an entry: u16 0x0644 + u32 count + count x 40-byte element records [u64 ElementId][u32 idA][u32 idB][i32 idC or -1][u64 ElementId repeat][i64 previous/parent ElementId or -1][u32 0]; the self-id repeat is a hard invariant; skeleton entries have entry_len == L + 36.

Entry kinds: skeleton (~19–58 KB near-identical default-document scaffolds, majority), extended (up to 4.7 MB, hold the only strings: 'Floor Plans','Ceiling Plans','Elevations (Elevation 1)','3D Views','Revit Default DB Server' = family default view names), anomalous (racbasic 24, rstbasic 10: canonical structure overlaid with 0x45/0x7b/0x55/0xff fill-like values — unknown).

Cross-links proven: every CD GUID key (60/60 racbasic) appears once in Global/Latest inside ~92–100 B per-content-document summary records ((u32 classId,u32 count) pairs + GUID + UTF-16 'Autodesk Revit') and once in exactly one Partitions/15 block; class id 0x341 (833) appears both in CD element records and as a Latest count key.

Deflate anomaly diagnosed: racadv/dach ContentDocuments and dach/rme ElemTable fail mid-stream at an invalid dynamic-block header after a clean run of full 16k-symbol blocks — not Deflate64, not truncation, not extraction error (OLE chains contiguous, bytes byte-identical), no single-bit repair. Recovery implemented: strict dynamic-header resync + primed-window decode reaching the end signature (racadv resumes at raw 356,781 → 781,501 B; dach at 6,865,883 → 1,548,828 B; dach's stale ISIZE 39.3 MB implies its 5.2 MB compressed hole holds ~29 MB of content documents).

Byte-level: ContentDocuments GUID keys are stored bytes_le (v4 version nibble at bytes 6..7 LE) exactly like History episode GUIDs; the earlier project GUID index (bin-le) missed them only because it did not scan this stream.
confidence: History layout and semantics: high (six files, exact length reconciliation, BasicFileInfo GUID identity, v1 timestamps, lineage overlaps). Global envelope/end-signature/trailer/padding/footer framing: high. ContentDocuments container (GUID-keyed ordered map, entry markers, 100% coverage, element-record table layout): high. ContentDocuments interpretation (embedded family/content documents, ElementId = owner family, tag→ADocument-field mapping): medium (strong circumstantial, needs the class-id table and one ElemTable lookup to confirm). Cause of the deflate holes, anomalous overlay entries, footer blob meaning, History header GUID and 0x28 tag byte: low/unresolved and documented as unknowns.
open_questions: What causes the mid-stream deflate hole in racadv/dach ContentDocuments and dach/rme ElemTable (corpus damage vs. an append/session-splice writer behaviour), and does Revit itself read through it?

What are the 24 (racbasic) / 10 (rstbasic) 'anomalous' CD entries whose id/count/zero fields are overlaid with 0x45/0x7b/0x55/0xff fill-like bytes — unloaded cache slots, a different sub-encoding, or interleaved data?
What is the opaque footer blob (37–350 B) after the trailer's zero padding in every Global stream (History clusters at 91 B, PartitionTable at 37 B)? Not deflate at any offset.

Class-tag names: 0x0538 (history), 0x03a3/0x03a2 (entry-marker null pointers), prologue tags 0x001c/0x05c9/0x03a7/0x01a0/0x1066/0x0ff8/0x0ae9, container tag 0x0644 — need the Formats/Latest class-id table.
Meaning of the History header GUID slots (G,G,G,ZERO,G — a GUID that appears nowhere else in the file) and of the constant per-episode tag byte 0x28.
Are the CD element-record fields A/B/C (808/833/837 racbasic, 975/1003 rstbasic, 541/562 rstadv, …) class ids, category element ids, or per-document ordinals — they scale per file.

Is the ElementId at CD entry +0x58 really ADocument::m_ownerFamilyId (a Family element), i.e. are content documents the loaded family documents? Resolve host element 1,018,036 (racbasic) via ElemTable/Partitions.

Meaning of the u32 L at entry +0x1c for extended entries (first-block size), and the structure of the multi-MB extended payloads beyond the first block; what fills dach's unreadable 5.2 MB gap (stale ISIZE says the true payload is ~39 MB).
What does the per-stream-type 8-byte prefix (1 for CD/History/DocumentIncrementTable, 0 for ElemTable/PartitionTable, 5 for Latest) select?
next_steps: Get the Formats/Latest class-id -> name table from the schema agent (A2) and re-label every u16 tag here (0x0538, 0x03a3/0x03a2, prologue tags, 0x0644) and the u32 record ids (808/833/…): this converts most hypotheses into named ADocument fields.

Resolve host ElementId 1,018,036 (0xf88b4, racbasic content document #0; 385 hits in Partitions/15 member 233) against ElemTable/Partitions to confirm ContentDocuments = embedded family documents and to name each entry (family name per GUID key).

Decode Global/Latest's per-content-document summary table (records at Latest 975, 1067, 1159, … containing (classId,count) pairs + the CD GUID + 'Autodesk Revit'): it is the index of m_oContentTable and probably carries per-document element counts/paths (A5 slice — flagged in docs/inbox/content-history.md).

Update KNOWLEDGE/TRACKER: trailer is a real gzip trailer (valid for small streams, stale for appended ones); end signature 00 00 ff ff 02 0c 00; footer = A10; and add ElemTable deflate holes in dach/rme to the ElemTable agent's queue (recovery code reusable: rvt.content.inflate_global).

Investigate the deflate hole: try (a) treating the gap as a separately-primed segment continued from an older file version's dictionary, (b) checking whether Revit/APS opens dach and racadv cleanly (if yes, the reader tolerates or bypasses ContentDocuments/ElemTable — implying they are rebuildable caches), (c) obtaining a fresh copy of the sample downloads to rule out corpus bit-rot.

Diff extended vs skeleton entries structurally (walk the tagged sections after the 0x0644 table: 0x096a index map, 9-byte flag+id runs, the trailing double transform) to extend the entry region map into the multi-MB family payloads; harvest their few UTF-16 strings (view names) as anchors.

Wire rvt.content into src/rvt/cli.py (e.g. `history` and `content` subcommands) once the container spine settles; the module already exposes inflate_global / parse_history / scan_content_documents / element_records.
